# Yahoo Finance

> Yahoo Finance provides real-time stock quotes, market data, portfolio management tools, and comprehensive financial news covering stocks, crypto, earnings, and economic analysis.

Yahoo Finance is a leading financial information platform offering live market quotes, investment tracking, and news coverage of global markets, tech stocks, cryptocurrencies, and economic trends. The site serves both casual investors and active traders with real-time data, analysis, and curated financial content.

## Key Topics

- Stock Market Data
- Real-time Quotes
- Portfolio Management
- Market Analysis
- Financial News
- Tech Stocks
- Cryptocurrency & Bitcoin
- Earnings Reports
- Market Indices (S&P 500, Nasdaq)
- Economic News & Fed Policy
- Market Screeners
- Investment Analysis
- Global Markets
- Trading Volume
- Market Trends

## Core Market Data & Tools

- [Yahoo Finance Homepage](https://finance.yahoo.com): Yahoo Finance homepage with live stock quotes, market indices, news and financial tools
- [Markets Overview](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets): Market overview with global indices, futures, bonds, currencies and ETFs
- [Portfolio Tracker](https://finance.yahoo.com/portfolios): Portfolio tracker for managing stocks, watch lists and investment performance
- [Most Active Stocks](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/most-active): Most active stocks list with volume analysis and market screener
- [Top Stock Gainers](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/gainers): Top gaining stocks screener with daily performance and price tracking
- [Top Stock Losers](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/losers): Top losing stocks screener with daily losses and market data
- [US Stocks Screener](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks): Most active US stocks screener with trading volume and real-time quotes

## Financial News & Analysis

- [Finance News Hub](https://finance.yahoo.com/news): Financial news hub covering Wall Street, markets, stocks and investment analysis
- [Latest News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/latest-news): Latest financial news and market updates from Yahoo Finance
- [Stock Market News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/stock-market-news): Latest stock market news with analysis on tech stocks, earnings and valuations
- [Economic News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/economic-news): Economic news on Fed policy, interest rates, inflation and employment
- [Technology News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/tech): Technology sector news covering AI, SpaceX, tech stocks and IPOs
- [Earnings Reports](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/earnings): Earnings reports, whispers and analysis for quarterly company earnings

## Specialized Coverage

- [Cryptocurrency & Bitcoin News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/crypto): Cryptocurrency news covering Bitcoin, Ethereum, altcoins and blockchain
- [Tariffs & Trade Policy](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/tariffs): News and analysis on tariffs, trade policy and stock market impact
- [Housing Market News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/housing-market): Housing market news on mortgage rates, real estate and homebuying
- [Tax News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/hrb-2026): Tax news covering deductions, filing, credits and H&R Block coverage

## Premium & Original Content

- [Yahoo Finance Originals](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/yahoo-finance-originals): Yahoo Finance original content on markets, stocks and economic analysis
- [Premium News](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/premium-news): Premium subscriber-only financial news and market analysis content

## Subscriptions & Newsletters

- [Newsletter Signup](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/sign-up-for-yahoo-finances-morning-brief-174158888.html): Newsletter signup for Morning Brief and other Yahoo Finance email subscriptions
